_doc: How a monster's own attack is said in a line (src/monster.py attack_noun, attack_line; round 3, 2026-11-14: 'a game about grammar should use it'). A blow is 'The Goblin hits you with his rusty knife', with the creature's possessive (data/monsters.json pronoun). An attack whose name is a verb is said as one: attack_verbs gives the predicate ('engulfs' -> 'The Gelatinous Cube engulfs you for 4 damage!'); a predicate with 'you' or 'your' in it is used as written ('leads you astray'), any other is followed by 'you'. proper_words keep their capitals when the rest of the name is lower-cased ('Euryale's wail', 'the words of Thoth'); an attack whose first word is one of them takes no possessive ('with Euryale's wail').

attack_verbs.Red-Hot Hug: hugs you to a red-hot chest
